riftwoven.seed.tooltip: Plant in a stone, crying-obsidian and amethyst formation. Materials shape a finite world.
riftwoven.seed.reference: A persistent realm reference. Copies share the same world and discoveries.
riftwoven.advancement.plant.title: Shape the seed
riftwoven.advancement.plant.description: Craft a Realm Seed. Place it on five stone blocks between three-high crying-obsidian uprights capped with amethyst.
riftwoven.advancement.awaken.title: Discover the world
riftwoven.advancement.awaken.description: Offer materials, inspect the profile, then sneak and hold use with four diamonds to awaken your finite realm.
riftwoven.advancement.return.title: A thread home
riftwoven.advancement.return.description: The arrival core returns you home. For emergency extraction, empty both hands, look up, sneak and hold use for thirty seconds.
